claims.reason: Three proofs repeat the same passage from the degree-one inclusion `map f P ≤ Q` to `x ∈ P ^ n → f x ∈ Q ^ n`. Each does `pow_le_pow_left'` plus `Submodule.map_pow`, and each rebuilds the `⟨x, hx, rfl⟩` image witness. In the second and third proofs this is spelled out with the `.toAlgHom.toLinearMap` coercion blocks `hx'` and `hp'`. The only real mathematical content that differs is the degree-one inclusion `h₁`. The lemma needs only `f : A →ₐ[R] B` and submodules `P`, `Q`, so no assumptions are lost. It uses only `Submodule.map_pow` and `pow_le_pow_left'`, which are already imported, so it introduces no dependency cycle. The lemma is small, so the gain is mostly maintenance: one place for the coercion handling, and each theorem shows only its `h₁`.
claims.shared_lemma:
private theorem mem_pow_of_map_le {R A B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) {P : Submodule R A} {Q : Submodule R B} (h : Submodule.map f.toLinearMap P ≤ Q) {n : ℕ} {x : A} (hx : x ∈ P ^ n) : f x ∈ Q ^ n := by
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left' h n
  rw [← Submodule.map_pow] at hpow
  exact hpow ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
rewritten_uses: map_mem_homogeneousSubmodule: after proving h₁ as at present, finish with `exact mem_pow_of_map_le (map f) h₁ hx`.

equivMvPolynomial_mem_homogeneousSubmodule: keep the span-induction proof of h₁ into `homogeneousSubmodule I R 1`, then `rw [← MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_pow]; exact mem_pow_of_map_le (equivMvPolynomial b).toAlgHom h₁ hx`.

equivMvPolynomial_symm_mem_homogeneousSubmodule: keep h₁ for the symm map, then `rw [← MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_pow] at hp; exact mem_pow_of_map_le (equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toAlgHom h₁ hp`.

protected theorem map_pow {A'} [Semiring A'] [Algebra R A'] (f : A →ₐ[R] A') (n : ℕ) :
    map f.toLinearMap (M ^ n) = map f.toLinearMap M ^ n
